# Bindle

> Bindle is observability for AI agents: every step an agent takes (LLM calls, tool calls, decisions, handoffs) with cost, latency, failures and runaway-loop alerts. Agents send OpenTelemetry traces over OTLP/HTTP; the Python SDK sets that up in one line.

Facts for coding agents adding Bindle to a project:

- Install: `pip install bindle-sdk` (extras per framework: `bindle-sdk[langchain]`, `[openai-agents]`, `[crewai]`, `[llama-index]`, `[openai,anthropic,bedrock]`). Strands Agents needs no extra.
- Code: `import bindle` then `bindle.init(agent="my-agent", version="v1", environment="dev")` once at startup, before building chains, agents or crews.
- Config comes from the environment: `BINDLE_API_KEY` (required, an ingest key `bd_live_...` created on the console's Ingest keys page) and `BINDLE_ENDPOINT` (default `https://ingest.bindle.ai`).
- Never hard-code the key, print it, or ask the user to paste it into chat. Put it in `.env` (git-ignored) or the deployment's secret store.
- Without a key the SDK does nothing, so the `init()` line is safe to commit. The SDK never raises into the agent and never blocks it.
- Serverless (AWS Lambda and similar): call `bindle.flush()` before the handler returns.
- Custom code: `@bindle.trace_tool`, `@bindle.trace_step`, `with bindle.step("name", type="decision")`, `bindle.decision(...)`, `bindle.handoff(...)`, `bindle.set_session(id)`.
- Prompts and outputs are redacted on the client and again on the server; secrets are dropped. Workspace owners can lower the sample rate, turn off content capture or add redaction patterns from the console without a redeploy.
- Apps that already use OpenTelemetry need no SDK: send OTLP/HTTP (protobuf or JSON) to `$BINDLE_ENDPOINT/v1/traces` with header `authorization: Bearer $BINDLE_API_KEY`.

## Setup tools

- `bindle init`: detects the framework, saves the key to `.env`, checks the connection, sends a test trace and prints the code to add.
- `bindle check`: verifies the key and endpoint without sending data.
- `bindle mcp`: an MCP server (stdio) with tools `bindle_setup_guide`, `bindle_detect_framework`, `bindle_check_connection` and `bindle_send_test_trace`. Claude Code: `claude mcp add bindle -- bindle mcp`.
